4 monthsLead Full-Stack Developer

E-Commerce Platform

▲Next.js
📘TypeScript
🐘PostgreSQL
🔴Redis
💳Stripe
☁️AWS
Problem

Traditional e-commerce platforms struggled with flash sales, causing site crashes and overselling. The client needed a scalable solution that could handle traffic spikes while maintaining real-time inventory accuracy.

Solution
  • Implemented Redis caching layer with cache warming strategies
  • Built event-driven architecture using webhooks for inventory updates
  • Integrated Stripe Tax API with fallback calculation engine
Result

The platform now handles 10,000+ daily active users with 99.9% uptime. Conversion rates increased by 35%, and the system processed over $2M in transactions within the first 6 months.

6 monthsTech Lead & ML Engineer

AI Analytics Dashboard

⚛️React
🐍Python
🧠TensorFlow
📊D3.js
🌊Kafka
🐘PostgreSQL
Problem

Businesses struggled to make sense of vast amounts of data. Existing tools were either too complex for non-technical users or lacked predictive capabilities needed for proactive decision-making.

Solution
  • Implemented data streaming with Apache Kafka
  • Built custom D3.js components with interactive features
  • Used transfer learning to bootstrap models with small datasets
Result

The dashboard reduced decision-making time by 60% and identified over $500K in cost savings. The platform achieved 94% prediction accuracy and onboarded 50+ enterprise clients.

5 monthsMobile Lead Developer

Social Media App

📱React Native
🔥Firebase
🔄Redux
🟢Node.js
🧠TensorFlow Lite
Problem

Existing social platforms felt impersonal and cluttered. Users wanted a more intimate, interest-based connection platform with better privacy controls and less algorithmic manipulation.

Solution
  • Used Firebase Realtime Database with optimistic updates
  • Built automated cleanup jobs with Firebase Functions
  • Implemented collaborative filtering with content-based recommendations
Result

The app achieved 100K+ downloads in the first 3 months with a 4.8-star rating. Users send over 2M messages daily, with a 45% daily active user rate indicating strong engagement.
